articles.mainIdea: Stocks to Watch Friday: Intel, GM, Rio Tinto, Glencore
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Stocks to Watch Friday: Intel, GM, Rio Tinto, Glencore. ↗️ Intel (INTC): President Trump said late Thursday he had "just finished a great meeting" with Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan. The chipmaker's shares gained 2.5% in premarket trading. The U.S. has said it will convert around $9 billion in federal grants into a 10% equity stake in Intel. Related tickers mentioned: FNMA, GLCNF, GLNCY, GM, INTC, RIO, RTNTF, RTPPF.
